marks.gloss_en: if what disqualifies in the lung is fit in the kidney, all the more so what is fit in the lung is fit in the kidney
שהרי נקב פסול בריאה וכשר בכוליא -- a perforation disqualifies in the lung yet is fit in the kidney
the West: whatever disqualifies in the lung is fit in the kidney
R' Tanchuma: הרי מוגלא, דכשר בריאה ופסול בכוליא -- a counterexample to the conclusion itself (filed as pircha; the format has no counterexample ground)
Rav Ashi: טרפות קא מדמית להדדי? -- one does not reason from one organ's tereifot to another's: cut here it dies, cut there it lives
מתקיף לה רבי תנחומא: וכללא הוא? הרי מוגלא, דכשר בריאה ופסול בכוליא!
אלא אמר רב אשי: טרפות קא מדמית להדדי? אין אומרים בטרפות זו דומה לזו
R' Tanchuma: pus -- fit in the lung
and where is the place of the crevice? at the white [matter] beneath the loins
and as to Rav Avira too, we said [the halakha is not as he] only in its thin end
and clear fluid is fit -- we said so only where it is unclouded
a kidney that shrank: in a small animal -- until a bean
תא שמע, דתניא: חרותה בידי אדם טרפה, ר' שמעון בן אלעזר אומר: אף בידי כל הבריות -- the baraita sets his 'even' after the tereifa clause (the standard reading of the proof: so he extends the stringency)
the baraita: [a lung] shriveled by human hands -- tereifa; R' Shimon ben Elazar says: even by the hands of any creature
the mishna: [a lung] shriveled by the hand of Heaven -- fit
R' Shimon ben Elazar stands on the first clause, and to leniency [shriveling by any creature counts with 'by the hand of Heaven' -- fit]
Rabba bar bar Chana found rams whose lungs were shriveled and came and asked in the study hall [how the cause is to be determined]
the mishna: its em removed [-- fit]
מכלל דלר' שמעון בן אלעזר פליג ר' מאיר בגלודה? והתניא: אמר ר' שמעון בן אלעזר: לא נחלקו -- 'he retracted' implies R' Meir once disagreed, but RSBE also says they did not disagree
מאי לא נחלקו? לא עמד ר' מאיר במחלוקתו -- 'did not disagree' means he did not hold to his dispute (= p_rnby_lo_amad), so both reports agree
R' Shimon ben Elazar: R' Meir and the Sages did not disagree about the flayed animal, that it is invalid
the mishna's clause: the flayed animal [-- R' Meir validates, the Sages invalidate]
איבעיא להו: דאריך וקטין דכי מצרף לה הוי כסלע, או דלמא ברוחב סלע על פני השדרה כולה? תא שמע דפריש רבי נהוראי משמיה דשמואל: ברוחב כסלע -- the long-thin alternative is not Shmuel's meaning
R' Nehorai explained in Shmuel's name: the width of a sela along the whole spine
דתניא: ...אחד עור בית הפרסות... משום רבי יעקב / משום רבי שמעון -- the hooves' hide counted as flesh is taught in the names of single tannaim

the baraita: one who slaughters a burnt-offering intending to burn an olive-bulk of the hide beneath the tail outside its place -- unfit, and no karet; outside its time -- piggul, and one is liable to karet for it
אמר ליה: לימדתנו רבינו, אלו שעורותיהן כבשרן -- עור בית הפרסות! you taught us the mishna that lists the hooves' hide as like flesh (kind tnan under protest: the formula is לימדתנו, not תנן)
אמר ליה: אל תקניטני, שבלשון יחיד אני שונה אותה (= p_ry_bilshon_yachid)
the mishna (122a), cited by R' Asi: these are those whose hide is like their flesh -- [among them] the hide of the hooves
the baraita (55b.14), re-cited: if [a piece of hide] as large as a sela remained on it, it is fit
Rabba bar bar Chana: [the sela must be at] the tips of the joints
Rav: all the hide saves in a flayed animal, except the hide of the hooves

R' Yaakov / R' Shimon: whether the hide of the hooves, the hide of the head of a tender calf, the hide beneath the tail, or all that the Sages listed for impurity as 'whose hide is like their flesh' -- to include the hide of the genitals -- outside its place: unfit, no karet; outside its time: piggul, with karet
the mishna: the lower jaw removed [-- fit]
